method: Review both independent pair deltas, all four run summaries and the slowest three cycles with per-request API durations for every repeatable positive metric. No reruns or samples discarded for being slow.
conclusion: Approved 20% AND 100 ms repeated-pair gate passes. Timing is not identical. Smaller increases and isolated Edge spikes remain documented; their exact causes are not all established.
limitations: Synthetic local fixtures, not production scale
20 ms readiness polling and WebDriver/frame overhead affect both variants
One cold sample per independent process
API execution timing is not end-to-end attribution; overlapping requests must not be naively subtracted
